description: This Java class 'OtaPackageImportService' extends a base entity import service to handle OTA package import logic, including setting ownership, preparing data, finding existing entities, copying, saving/updating, and defining the entity type.

classes.name: OtaPackageImportService
classes.description: A service class for importing OTA packages, extending base entity import functionality with specific logic for OTA packages.

methods.name: setOwner
methods.description: Sets the tenant ID as the owner of the OTA package.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Prepares the OTA package by setting its device profile ID using the provided ID provider.

methods.name: findExistingEntity
methods.description: Finds an existing OTA package either by default method or by tenant ID, title, and version if not found.

methods.name: deepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the OTA package.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves or updates the OTA package, handling URL-based packages differently.

methods.name: getEntityType
methods.description: Returns the entity type, which is OTA_PACKAGE.
